Subject: Compressing SOC2 + DPA review: proposed overlapping 60-min cadence

Alex / EngOps — thanks again for the quick sync earlier. We hear you: tight calendar window and a couple of overlapping stakeholders (security, legal, dev leads). Rather than a single long block, would you consider a compressed cadence: two focused 60-minute sessions run back-to-back on the same day (security-focused first, DPA/controls second), with the pen-test vendor joining an adjacent short readout?

Pros: smaller attendee lists per block, clearer agenda, and easier for technical folks to dip in/out. Cons: slightly tighter handoff between sessions. I attached a short 60-min agenda and an evidence map to make handoff simpler.

Proposed times (PST):
- Option A: Tue, Jan 25 — 10:00–12:00 (two x 60m: 10:00–11:00 / 11:05–12:05)
- Option B: Wed, Jan 26 — 16:00–18:00 (two x 60m: 16:00–17:00 / 17:05–18:05)
- Option C: Thu, Jan 27 — 08:00–10:00 (two x 60m: 08:00–09:00 / 09:05–10:05)

If those don't work, share your best two-hour corridor and we’ll try to compress.

Prep that would help us run tightly:
- Short list of attendees per block (security, technical lead, procurement/legal)
- A nominated facilitator for the DPA block to run any contract questions so legal doesn’t have to sit through the whole technical session

Attachments: SOC2-DPA-60min-agenda.pdf, security-evidence-map.xlsx, proposed-invite.ics

Thanks — Karthik

--
